en.summary: Fixes LSU flush routing so flush requests bypass the normal save or MSHR admission path and go directly to the dcache control path.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says flush requests were wrongly sent into the MSHR path.
The patch changes the LSU address-calculation FSM in ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala.
The new state transition sends io.flush_dcache.fire to s_dcache while ordinary requests still go to s_save.
evidence: The old s_idle logic treated io.from_fifo.valid and io.flush_dcache.valid the same and always entered s_save.
The fixed code uses separate MuxCase branches for io.flush_dcache.fire and io.from_fifo.fire.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Flush and invalidate requests are cache-control operations, not normal load or store misses. The old logic routed a flush through the same save or MSHR admission path as ordinary memory traffic, which can wedge the LSU because that structure does not know how to complete a flush.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush or invalidate request arrives while the LSU is idle and the design has a dedicated cache-control path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Route the flush through the normal miss-save or MSHR path instead of the dedicated cache-control path.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: route special request through normal pending structure
portability_notes: Apply this where flush or invalidate requests share an LSU with normal memory traffic.
The bug is in request routing, not in flush opcode encoding.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the state machine that dispatches normal memory requests versus cache-control requests.
Remove the special branch that sends flush directly to the cache-control state or port.
Allow the flush request to enter the same save or allocation path as a normal miss.
Leave downstream flush opcode generation unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AddrCalculate state transition in s_idle for io.flush_dcache versus io.from_fifo
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes a fired flush request jump directly to s_dcache, while only ordinary memory requests enter s_save.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Collapse the separate io.flush_dcache.fire and io.from_fifo.fire cases back into one path that routes both to s_save.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A flush request can occupy the wrong pending structure, block the LSU or MSHR, and stall later memory traffic.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message states that the MSHR does not process flush-class requests and that this blocked the MSHR.
The only touched DUT file is ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala.
The patch only changes the routing decision in s_idle, which is exactly where special cache-control traffic is separated from ordinary traffic.
notes: This is a liveness or control bug more than a data-value corruption bug.
A reproducer usually needs a real flush request followed by later memory traffic.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 LSU 的 flush 路由逻辑，使 flush 请求绕过普通的 save 或 MSHR 进入路径，直接走 dcache 控制路径。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确指出 flush 请求被错误送入 MSHR 路径。
补丁修改的是 ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala 中的 LSU 地址计算状态机。
修复后 io.flush_dcache.fire 直接转到 s_dcache，而普通请求仍然进入 s_save。
evidence: 旧的 s_idle 逻辑把 io.from_fifo.valid 和 io.flush_dcache.valid 等同处理，并统一进入 s_save。
修复后的代码使用分开的 MuxCase 分支来区分 io.flush_dcache.fire 和 io.from_fifo.fire。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Flush 和 invalidate 请求属于 cache-control 操作，不是普通 load 或 store miss。旧逻辑把 flush 送入了普通 save 或 MSHR 进入路径，而那个结构并不知道如何完成 flush，因此会卡住 LSU。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当 LSU 空闲时到来一个 flush 或 invalidate 请求，并且设计中原本存在专用 cache-control 路径。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 不要让 flush 走专用 cache-control 路径，而是让它进入普通 miss-save 或 MSHR 路径。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: route special request through normal pending structure
portability_notes: 适用于 flush 或 invalidate 请求与普通访存共用 LSU 的设计。
该 bug 的核心是请求路由错误，而不是 flush opcode 编码错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位区分普通访存请求与 cache-control 请求的状态机。
删除将 flush 直接送到 cache-control 状态或端口的特殊分支。
让 flush 像普通 miss 一样进入 save 或分配路径。
保持下游 flush opcode 生成逻辑不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AddrCalculate 在 s_idle 中对 io.flush_dcache 与 io.from_fifo 的分流逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复后，握手成功的 flush 请求直接跳到 s_dcache，只有普通请求才进入 s_save。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把分开的 io.flush_dcache.fire 和 io.from_fifo.fire 分支重新合并，让二者都进入 s_save。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush 请求会进入错误的 pending 结构，堵塞 LSU 或 MSHR，并使后续访存停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 提交说明写明 MSHR 不会处理 flush 类请求，并且这会导致 MSHR 被堵住。
唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala。
补丁只改动了 s_idle 中的路由决策，这正是区分 cache-control 与普通访存流量的位置。
notes: 这更偏向活性或控制类 bug，而不是纯数据错误。
复现通常需要真实 flush 请求和后续访存流量。
